summary: Open http://127.0.0.1:3015/preview. Scoped local commit c7c2f8b delivers the owner-selected bright Play Pavilion: pearl ribbon, cyan court, coral ball and distinct All/Tennis/Running/Padel scenes. Production is unchanged.

Sport and city controls update matching invitations and share discovery filters. Trip dates and preferences survive; changing cities clears the old area. Separate + Join controls preserve full/requested/accepted/hosting states and exact-event authentication return.

Verified: 25 focused tests, all workspace typechecks, scoped lint and production build. Eleven pavilion cases passed across main/focused runs, five complete website journeys and three scale/travel cases passed. Final browser runs had zero page errors or prohibited requests.

Checked 1440/768/390/320 layouts, keyboard, reduced motion without renderer download, delayed loading with usable HTML controls, pause/offscreen/resume, actual WebGL context loss, missing photos before hydration, long titles, empty results, full games and blocked profiles. Final screenshots reviewed.

Local production-mode smoke: /preview is 404/noindex with no preview surface. Development preview remains available. Existing unfinished product work is preserved. No real account, outreach, payment or release; no scheduler changes or new unattended completion claimed.

Human evidence remains pending: four of five adults should complete selecting/requesting without assistance, and describe request versus acceptance. Next: owner/tester review, then approved production integration; attendance, repeat participation and settled subscriptions remain later learning gates.
headline: Play Pavilion is ready locally: a bright transforming sports sculpture with simple discovery and joining.
